description: Source code for a FastAPI-based microservice that manages reviews and ratings for different subjects such as hotels, orders, and couriers. It includes endpoints for creating reviews, listing reviews for hotels, and fetching aggregated rating data, with in-memory data storage and openAPI documentation.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a review with validation, including fields for id, subject, rating, comment, user, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: ReviewCreateRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new review, containing subjectId, subjectType, rating, comment, and optional userId.

classes.name: RatingAggregate
classes.description: Schema for aggregating ratings for a subject, including average, count, and distribution.

methods.name: _now_utc
methods.description: Returns the current UTC datetime with timezone awareness.

methods.name: _generate_id
methods.description: Generates a new UUID string for review IDs.

methods.name: _to_review_dict
methods.description: Converts a Review model instance into a dict with ISO timestamp for serialization.

methods.name: list_reviews
methods.description: Retrieve a list of reviews for a specified hotelId, sorted by creation date descending.

methods.name: create_review
methods.description: Create and store a new review instance in memory, returning the created Review model.

methods.name: get_rating_aggregate
methods.description: Calculate and return aggregate rating data for a specified hotelId.

methods.name: docs_ws_note
methods.description: Provides a note about WebSocket absence and polling recommendation.

methods.name: root
methods.description: A simple endpoint providing service info and available endpoints.
